title: Module Manifest
description: Declares the public boundary of one modular slice of the Kreile app: what it exports for other modules to consume, what database and storage objects it owns, what domain events it emits/consumes, and what it depends on. Pre-Path-1 manifests live under docs/architecture/modules/<moduleId>.manifest.json (documentation-as-data, F0-07). Path 1 modules (ARCHITEKTUR_MODULE_PATH1.md) carry their manifest INSIDE the module as src/modules/<moduleId>/<moduleId>.manifest.json; there it is CI-enforced by scripts/quality/check-module-gates.mjs (S1): moduleId == folder, public.ts exists, publicExports = '@/modules/<moduleId>/public#Symbol'.

moduleId.description: Stable, unique identifier for the module, kebab-case.

version.description: Version of this manifest's contract (semver). Bump when publicExports, capabilities, or events change in a breaking way.

owner.description: Person, role, or team accountable for this module.

publicExports.description: Symbols or module paths (e.g. '@/lib/erfassung/snapshot#getKostensatz') that other modules are permitted to import. Anything not listed here is a module-internal implementation detail and must not be imported cross-module.

capabilities.description: Named capabilities/permissions this module provides or requires (e.g. 'erfassung:write').

migrations.description: Filenames under supabase/migrations/ that this module owns and is responsible for evolving.

viewsFunctions.description: Database views and functions this module owns, schema-qualified (e.g. 'public.fn_erfassung_snapshot'). Cross-module read contracts MUST be 'public.v_*' views listed here (Path 1 Naht 4); scripts/quality/check-module-gates.mjs only accepts v_* views that some manifest declares.

ownsTables.description: Base tables this module owns, schema-qualified ('public.orders', 'private.invoice_numbers'). SQL under src/modules/<moduleId>/ may touch ONLY these tables directly; every other module's facts come in via declared public.v_* views (Path 1 Naht 4, enforced by scripts/quality/check-module-gates.mjs).

storagePurposes.description: Storage buckets this module owns and what each is used for.

events.description: Domain events this module emits and/or consumes, for future cross-module wiring.

config.description: Module-specific configuration keys (env vars, feature flags) mapped to a short description of each.

dependencies.description: moduleId values of other modules this module depends on.
